title: Separating retrieval coverage from answer support
method: Synthetic evaluation of 100 answerable questions. Retrieval supplies sufficient evidence for 80; generation supports 72 of those. End-to-end success is 72%, and conditional generation success is 72/80 = 90%. The ceiling assumes the generator has no other approved source.
alt: Separating retrieval coverage from answer support. Known-answer questions: 100 questions out of 100, Sufficient evidence found: 80 questions out of 100, Supported final answers: 72 questions out of 100. Illustrative data.
